comoFuncionaProceso.introDestacado: You just plug in the cable — we handle the technical work!
comoFuncionaProceso.introAclaracion: Important note: we don't sell self-service programs. We deliver a direct solution to your printer's board.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions | ResetEntuPC.com
faq.description: We answer the most common questions about the reset installation, what it covers and how the process works.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions

items.respuesta: An Installation: the right to install the reset software on a single PC. The activation key (Key) is only the means to enable the program; what we provide is the installation.

items.pregunta: Can I try it before buying?
items.respuesta: Yes. If you want to be sure before buying, request a Trial Key over WhatsApp. It is provided only once.

items.pregunta: Is there a refund if the program doesn't fix my problem?
items.respuesta: Since what we sell is an installation, there are no refunds once the Key has been delivered, whether or not the program fixes your printer's problem. That's why, before buying, check which errors it covers and, if you wish, test it with the Trial Key.

items.pregunta: On how many computers can I use it, and how long does it last?
items.respuesta: The installation is tied to the PC where it is activated and lasts as long as you decide: it can be 1 day or 20 years. If you format the PC, change the hard drive or move it to another computer, the installation is lost and you would need to buy a new one.

items.pregunta: Which errors does it fix, and which not?
items.respuesta: It only resets the ink pad counters. Epson: ink pad error, E11 and cap error. Canon: 5B00, 1700, P07 and E08. Epson SC plotters: 00000008, 00080000, 00040000, 00000004, 00010000, 00000001, 0014BD. It does not fix physical problems, print quality, printhead cleaning, the maintenance box or cartridge failures.

items.pregunta: Do I have to do it myself, or do you access my PC?
items.respuesta: It is a "do it yourself" service: you run the process by following our videos and stay in full control of your computer. We do not provide remote assistance or access your PC. You only need to connect the printer with a USB cable.

items.pregunta: Which antivirus do I need to use?
items.respuesta: Only Windows Defender. If you have any other antivirus, you must uninstall it completely (pausing it is not enough). You also need to exclude the folder C:\ResetEntuPc.com in Windows Defender.

items.pregunta: What if the antivirus deletes the program?
items.respuesta: The installation manager includes a "Reinstall" button. If the antivirus removes the program by mistake, you can recover it with that button without losing your activation, as long as you have not formatted the PC.

items.pregunta: How do I get my Key?
items.respuesta: You download the installer, install the reset for your printer model and copy your PC ID. Then you message us on WhatsApp with that ID and we generate your Key to activate it.

objeto.p1Fuerte: 100% Remote Assisted Reset via USB Connection
objeto.p1Despues: . ResetEntuPC does not sell software, licenses, or reset programs. The technical tools used while providing the service are merely a means of delivering it, not the product being contracted.

naturaleza.p1: ResetEntuPC's technician does not access the client's computer. The client only temporarily shares their printer's USB port through the corresponding connection tool.
naturaleza.p2Despues: . This tool only establishes communication between the client's printer and the server where the technician works. The reset itself is performed remotely by the technician, without accessing the client's equipment beyond that printer connection.

reembolsos.p1: Before payment is confirmed, a technical review is carried out to verify the equipment's compatibility with the contracted service.
reembolsos.li1: If, following that review, the equipment turns out not to be compatible, a refund applies.
reembolsos.li2: If the procedure fails to complete the contracted reset, a refund applies.
reembolsos.li3Antes: Once the reset is deemed successful,
reembolsos.p2: The reset is considered successful when the counter covered by the service has been reset and the specific contracted error has been cleared. Resetting does not mean repairing.

exclusiones.titulo: 5. What the service does not include
exclusiones.intro: The Assisted Reset service does not include, among other things:
items: Physical repair, physical cleaning, or physical maintenance of the equipment
Repair of printers that do not power on
Print quality issues (blurry or blank printouts)
In general, any type of physical repair

instalacion.titulo: We sell an Installation, NOT a Repair
instalacion.p1: You are purchasing the right to INSTALL the software on ONE SINGLE PC. The activation key (Key) is only the means of enabling the program, but our service is the installation. Therefore, THERE ARE NO REFUNDS once the Key has been delivered, regardless of whether or not the program solves your printer's problem.

unicoPc.p1: The installation is linked exclusively to the machine where it is activated. How long it lasts depends on you (it may last 1 day or 20 years). If you format your PC, change your hard drive or try to move it to another computer, you will lose the installation immediately and will have to purchase a new one.

funcion.p1: The program ONLY resets the waste ink pad counters. It does NOT fix physical problems, print quality, printhead cleaning, the maintenance box or cartridge failures.
items: Epson: Only the Ink Pad error, E11 and the cap error.

autonomo.p1: This is a 'Do it yourself' service. You carry out the process by following our videos. We do NOT provide remote assistance and we do not access your PC. Connecting the printer by USB CABLE is essential.
autonomo.nota: Note: If you are hesitant before buying, you can request a Trial Key (a test key) by WhatsApp, one time only.

antivirus.p1: Using Windows Defender ONLY is a MANDATORY REQUIREMENT. If you have any other antivirus, you must UNINSTALL it completely (pausing it is not enough). This installation manager has a 'Reinstall' button; if your antivirus deletes the program by mistake, you can reinstall it with that button to recover it without losing your activation (as long as you have not formatted).
